name: Playwright
description: Drive a real browser from your coding agent — navigate, click, fill forms and read the page through Playwright's accessibility tree.
longDescription:
Microsoft's official Playwright MCP server, run through `npx`.

It exposes browser automation as tools rather than screenshots: the agent reads the **accessibility tree**, so it acts on roles and names instead of pixel coordinates. That makes it deterministic and far cheaper in tokens than vision-based approaches.

- **Navigation**: open URLs, follow links, go back and forward
- **Interaction**: click, type, select, upload, drag
- **Inspection**: read the page as structured text, capture screenshots when you actually need pixels
- **Isolation**: each session gets its own browser profile

Installs as `mcpServers.playwright` — at user scope into Claude Code's `~/.claude.json`, at project scope into `.mcp.json`.
